paragraphs.zh: Es können Farbstoffe wie anorganische Pigmente, z.B. Eisenoxid, Titanoxid, Ferrocyanblau und organische Farbstoffe, wie Alizarin-, Azo- und Metallphthalocyaninfarbstoffe und Spurennährstoffe wie Salze von Eisen, Mangan, Bor, Kupfer, Kobalt, Molybdän und Zink verwendet werden.
paragraphs.en: Colorants may be used, such as inorganic pigments, e.g. iron oxide, titanium oxide, ferrocyan blue, and organic dyestuffs such as alizarin, azo and metal phthalocyanine dyestuffs, and trace nutrients such as salts of iron, manganese, boron, copper, cobalt, molybdenum and zinc.
paragraphs.notes: The hyphens in "Alizarin-, Azo- und Metallphthalocyaninfarbstoffe" are real German suspended-compound hyphens, not line-break hyphenation: the sense is Alizarinfarbstoffe, Azofarbstoffe, Metallphthalocyaninfarbstoffe. "Ferrocyanblau" is left as the printed substance name and rendered literally in en.

paragraphs.zh: Die Formulierungen enthalten im allgemeinen zwischen 0,1 und 95 Gewichtsprozent des Wirkstoffs in der erfindungsgemäßen Kristallmodifikationen I, vorzugsweise zwischen 0,5 und 90 %.
paragraphs.en: The formulations generally contain between 0,1 and 95 percent by weight of the active ingredient in the crystal modification I according to the invention, preferably between 0,5 and 90 %.
paragraphs.notes: Printed as "in der erfindungsgemaessen Kristallmodifikationen I": singular article with plural noun. Transcribed as printed, not corrected. This paragraph spells the unit out as "Gewichtsprozent" and then as "%"; it does not use the form "Gew.-%". German decimal commas (0,1 / 0,5) kept as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Die erfindungsgemäße Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione kann als solche oder in ihren Formulierungen auch in Mischung mit bekannten Herbiziden und/oder mit Stoffen, welche die Kulturpflanzen-Verträglichkeit verbessern ("Safenern") zur Unkrautbekämpfung verwendet werden, wobei Fertigformulierungen oder Tankmischungen möglich sind. Es sind also auch Mischungen mit Unkrautbekämpfungsmitteln möglich, welche ein oder mehrere bekannte Herbizide und einen Safener enthalten.
paragraphs.en: The crystal modification I of tembotrione according to the invention can be used as such or in its formulations, also in a mixture with known herbicides and/or with substances which improve crop plant compatibility ("safeners"), for weed control, ready-mix formulations or tank mixes both being possible. Mixtures with weed control agents which contain one or more known herbicides and a safener are therefore also possible.
paragraphs.notes: "Kulturpflanzen-Vertraeglichkeit" carries a real compound hyphen, not line-break hyphenation. The word "Herbizide" was split as "Her-bizide" across a line break and has been rejoined. The quotation marks around "Safenern" are straight double quotes as printed.

paragraphs.en: Known safeners furthermore come into consideration for the mixtures, for example AD-67, BAS-145138, Benoxacor, Cloquintocet (-mexyl), Cyometrinil, Cyprosulfamide, 2,4-D, DKA-24, Dichlormid, Dymron, Fenclorim, Fenchlorazol (-ethyl), Flurazole, Fluxofenim, Furilazole, Isoxadifen (-ethyl), MCPA, Mecoprop (-P), Mefenpyr (-diethyl), MG-191, Oxabetrinil, PPG-1292, R-29148.
paragraphs.notes: 24 comma-separated safener entries, all transcribed. "Fen-chlorazol" was split across a line break and rejoined to Fenchlorazol. "MG-" fell at a line break followed by "191": that hyphen is a real part of the code name MG-191 and was kept, unlike the typographic hyphens elsewhere on the page. AD-67, BAS-145138, DKA-24, MG-191, PPG-1292 and R-29148 are development code designations rather than common names and are left exactly as printed in both fields. No registered or trademark mark is printed anywhere on this page.

paragraphs.zh: Auch eine Mischung mit anderen bekannten Wirkstoffen, wie Fungiziden, Insektiziden, Akariziden, Nematiziden, Schutzstoffen gegen Vogelfraß, Pflanzennährstoffen und Bodenstrukturverbesserungsmitteln ist möglich.
paragraphs.en: A mixture with other known active ingredients, such as fungicides, insecticides, acaricides, nematicides, agents protecting against bird damage, plant nutrients and soil structure improvers, is also possible.

paragraphs.zh: Die erfindungsgemäße Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione kann als solche, in Form ihrer Formulierungen oder den daraus durch weiteres Verdünnen bereiteten Anwendungsformen, wie gebrauchsfertige Lösungen, Suspensionen, Emulsionen, Pulver, Pasten und Granulate angewandt werden. Die Anwendung geschieht in üblicher Weise, z.B. durch Gießen, Spritzen, Sprühen, Streuen.
paragraphs.en: The crystal modification I of tembotrione according to the invention can be applied as such, in the form of its formulations, or in the use forms prepared from these by further dilution, such as ready-to-use solutions, suspensions, emulsions, powders, pastes and granules. Application is carried out in the customary manner, e.g. by pouring, spraying, atomising, scattering.
paragraphs.notes: "Suspen-sionen" was split across a line break and rejoined. Gießen / Spritzen / Sprühen / Streuen are four distinct application verbs and are rendered as pouring / spraying / atomising / scattering.

paragraphs.zh: Die erfindungsgemäße Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione kann sowohl vor als auch nach dem Auflaufen der Pflanzen appliziert werden. Sie kann auch vor der Saat in den Boden eingearbeitet werden.
paragraphs.en: The crystal modification I of tembotrione according to the invention can be applied both before and after emergence of the plants. It can also be incorporated into the soil before sowing.

paragraphs.zh: Die angewandte Wirkstoffmenge kann in einem größeren Bereich schwanken. Sie hängt im wesentlichen von der Art des gewünschten Effektes ab. Im allgemeinen liegen die Aufwandmengen zwischen 1 g und 1 kg Wirkstoff pro Hektar Bodenfläche, vorzugsweise zwischen 5 g und 500 g pro ha.
paragraphs.en: The amount of active ingredient applied can vary within a relatively wide range. It depends essentially on the nature of the desired effect. In general the application rates are between 1 g and 1 kg of active ingredient per hectare of soil surface, preferably between 5 g and 500 g per ha.
paragraphs.notes: Application rates as printed: between 1 g and 1 kg of active ingredient per hectare, preferably between 5 g and 500 g per ha. The page writes "pro Hektar Bodenflaeche" in full and then abbreviates to "pro ha"; it does not use the form "g/ha".

notes: Page 10 of EP 2 045 236 A1, description, continuous prose in a single full-width column with the EPO line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55 printed down the left margin. Those margin numbers are typographic furniture, not content, and are not recorded in any paragraph. Paragraphs [0042] to [0051] are present; [0051] is cut off mid-sentence and continues on page 11. The page carries no table and no table fragment, and no chemical structure or reaction scheme, so drawings is empty as a finding and not as an omission; this is consistent with the briefing, which places the single drawn structure of the document in [0002] on page 2. Nothing on the page is illegible. The German of the text layer was taken as authoritative for characters, as the briefing directs, and the layer encodes an unprintable control character (U+0003) wherever the typesetting used a non-breaking hyphen or non-breaking space, for example "(-<U+0003>sodium)" and "und/<U+0003>oder". Those control characters were stripped; they are an extraction artifact and no glyph corresponds to them on the page. This page describes formulation and application only. It states no synthesis, no reaction and no yield.
